disclaimer: Below are external community channels and groups. Only «Hack Germany Reference» (@germanypages) is reviewed by our editorial team — other resources are run by third parties and unverified. Always cross-check practical info with the official sources cited in the app guides.

telegramChannels.name: Тупа-Германия
telegramChannels.description: Largest Russian-speaking Germany channel (~14K): work, daily life, finance, news, tips.

telegramChannels.name: DW на русском — Что там у немцев?
telegramChannels.description: Deutsche Welle official Russian channel on life in Germany (~50K): society, tech, tips for newcomers.

telegramChannels.name: Чат «Русские в Германии»
telegramChannels.description: General chat for Russian-speaking residents of Germany: relocation, doctors, translators, meetups.

telegramChannels.name: Эмиграция в Германию. Поздние переселенцы
telegramChannels.description: Channel on Spätaussiedler relocation, Blue Card, insurance, work, business.

telegramChannels.name: Германия | Украина | Беженцы
telegramChannels.description: Major Russian-Ukrainian channel in Germany (~35K) with information for refugees and migrants; regional chats for Berlin, Bavaria.

telegramChannels.name: УКРАЇНЦІ В НІМЕЧЧИНІ
telegramChannels.description: Large community of Ukrainians in Germany (~40K): life, help, work, transport.

telegramChannels.name: Berlin helps Ukrainians
telegramChannels.description: Volunteer chat helping Ukrainian refugees in Berlin (~14K): housing, documents, medicine, legal.

telegramChannels.name: МОЙ ДОМ МЮНХЕН
telegramChannels.description: Largest Russian/Ukrainian channel about Munich and Bavaria (~14K): regional news, events.

telegramChannels.name: Белорусы в Германии
telegramChannels.description: Belarusian diaspora in Germany channel: EU and Belarus news, events. Separate chat @by_deutschland_chat.

telegramChannels.name: Networking Berlin
telegramChannels.description: Russian-speaking Berlin residents chat for networking, meetups, finding help.

telegramChannels.name: Русскоговорящая ГерманиЯ
telegramChannels.description: Russian-speaking Germany diaspora channel: news, community interviews, weekend streams.

telegramChannels.name: Ukrainer in Deutschland
telegramChannels.description: Support channel for Ukrainians in Germany (~38K): practical tips, announcements, mutual aid.
